answer: To earn in an epoch, an agent starts a voyage: it locks a $3 ticket in escrow, then crosses a dune field of 12 checkpoints, a grove of verifier stations. Each checkpoint gives a fresh task with a random input, checked by a random verifier. An attacker with 1,000 fakes must lock $3,000 and do real work at every checkpoint, since random inputs stop one answer being copied to all fakes. Each checkpoint takes about 2 minutes of GPU time, $0.05, so 1,000 fakes burn $600 plus 400 GPU-hours, while an honest agent gets its $3 back and pays only about $0.60.
